items.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. items.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram

items.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
items.summary: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need.
